jobs.occupation: Take your nursing career to Northern Norway
jobs.description: Imagine building your nursing career in one of Europe’s most spectacular regions, surrounded by Arctic nature, close-knit communities and a healthcare system where your skills are truly valued.We are recruiting EU-trained nurses for permanent positions in municipal healthcare services in Finnmark, Northern Norway. You will mainly work within home care services or nursing homes, providing important care and becoming part of an experienced and supportive healthcare team.Moving to another country is a big step, but you will not have to do it alone. We provide free Norwegian language training, assistance with authorisation, relocation support and personal follow-up throughout the entire process.Your main responsibilities include:    Providing home nursing care to patients in their own homes    Working in a nursing home or assisted living facility    Daily patient follow-up, medication management, observation and documentation    Close collaboration with relatives, GPs and other healthcare professionals    Contributing to quality improvement and development of local routinesWe are looking for someone who:    Has a valid license as a nurse from an EU/EEA country    Is motivated to obtain Norwegian authorisation (we assist with the process)    Speak fluent English and are highly motivated to learn Norwegian    Are willing to complete our free Norwegian language course    Works independently and in a structured way    Enjoys teamwork and has genuine compassion for patients    Is flexible and able to adapt to different work situations    Holds a driver’s license We offer:    A full-time permanent position    Competitive salary and working conditions    A warm, inclusive and supportive team    Opportunities for professional development    Free online Norwegian language course with a private teacher    Relocation assistance and help with housing    Personal follow-up throughout the recruitment and relocation processWhy Finnmark?Finnmark is Norway’s northernmost region and offers a different pace of life than larger cities. The region also offers unique experiences throughout the year, from the midnight sun in summer to the northern lights during winter.As a nurse in the municipal healthcare services, you will play an important role in the local community and work closely with patients, relatives and colleagues in a supportive and collaborative environment.Financial benefits of working in Finnmark:    Lower income tax rate (18.5% compared to 22% in the rest of Norway)    Additional annual tax deduction of up to NOK 45,000    No electricity consumption tax for households    Free kindergarten (meal costs may apply)    Additional child benefit for families with childrenApply today or get in touch with us for more information.

jobs.occupation: Chef - Sommarøy Arctic Hotel Tromsø
jobs.description:
Chef Wanted for Sommarøy - Seasonal Position with Possibility of Extension
Would you like to work as a chef in the beautiful surroundings of Sommarøy, just outside Tromsø? We are currently looking for a skilled and dedicated chef to join our team at Sommarøy Hotel for an exciting seasonal position.

This is a great opportunity for someone who enjoys working in a kitchen, takes pride in using quality ingredients, and would love to combine work with unforgettable nature experiences in Northern Norway.

The position is full-time (100%), starting in November and running until the end of March, with the possibility of extension.
Job Responsibilities
• Preparing and presenting dinner dishes and à la carte meals.
• Ensuring high standards of food quality and presentation.
• Contributing to the efficient and well-organised daily operation of the kitchen.
• Maintaining high standards of hygiene and following food safety procedures, including HACCP.
• Working closely with the kitchen team and other departments.
• Contributing to a positive working environment and excellent guest experiences.Qualifications
• Experience as a chef in a hotel, restaurant, or similar establishment.
• Experience with à la carte service.
• A professional chef qualification is preferred, but relevant work experience may compensate.
• Ability to work independently as well as part of a team.
• Good understanding of ingredients, food quality, and kitchen routines.
• Organised, flexible, and solution-oriented.
• Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment.
• Fluent in either Norwegian or English.What We Offer
• A full-time seasonal position from November until the end of March, with the possibility of extension.
• An exciting working environment surrounded by spectacular natural scenery.
• A friendly and international working environment.
• Staff accommodation available for only NOK 2,500 per month. You will have your own bedroom in a shared house with two other chefs.
• The opportunity to experience Northern Norway, with spectacular landscapes and the Northern Lights right on your doorstep.About Sommarøy Hotel
Sommarøy Hotel is situated in the scenic surroundings of Sommarøy, approximately a one-hour drive from Tromsø. Surrounded by the sea, mountains, and beautiful Northern Norwegian nature, the hotel attracts guests looking for unique experiences throughout the year.

Here, you will have the opportunity to become part of a kitchen team dedicated to creating memorable dining experiences for our guests.
Interested?
We would love to hear from you if you have kitchen experience and are ready for an exciting season on Sommarøy.

Please send us your application and CV as soon as possible. Applications will be reviewed on an ongoing basis.

 

We look forward to hearing from you!

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Sommarøy Hotel is a unique seaside hotel located on the beautiful island of Sommarøy, just one hour from Tromsø in Northern Norway. Surrounded by stunning Arctic nature, our hotel offers unforgettable experiences all year round, from the Northern Lights to the Midnight Sun. We are an international team passionate about great hospitality, quality food, and creating memorable experiences for our guests.

Work in the heart of Reine

• 

Spend your working days outdoors on the fjord

• 

Meet guests from all over the world

• 

Join a small, friendly and supportive team

• 

Possibility to work more than 50% by combining kayak guiding with shifts in other departments, depending on your experience and our operational needs

•

• 

is a certified kayak guide with sea kayaking experience

• 

has a full driving licence

• 

speaks fluent English

• 

is fit, reliable and comfortable working outdoors in changing weather

• 

is service-minded and good with people

• 

is available for the full period 15 June -- 15 August 2027

We hold our activities to a high standard, and our guided kayak tours have earned a high guest satisfaction score. We're looking for people who take pride in that standard and are committed to giving every activity guest an outstanding experience.

jobs.occupation: CLEANING SUPERVISOR  HOSTEL
jobs.description:
CLEANING SUPERVISOR – HOSTEL
Stockholm, Sweden
We are looking for a hands-on Cleaning Supervisor to join our growing hostel group in central Stockholm. This role is ideal for someone with strong cleaning experience who is organized, responsible and enjoys working with people in an international environment.
Who we are looking for
Previous experience in professional cleaning and preferably as a cleaning supervisor or team leader.

Strong cleaning skills and a good understanding of cleanliness and hygiene standards.

Able to communicate confidently in English, both spoken and written.

Responsible, organized and attentive to detail.

Comfortable supervising and coordinating a small team.

Positive, practical and willing to take initiative.

EU citizenship or permanent residency/work authorization in an EU country.

Experience in hospitality, hostels or hotels is a plus, as is education within hospitality or service.

You do not need extensive hospitality or management experience to be considered. If you have strong cleaning experience, the right attitude and are willing to learn, we are happy to train you in the other parts of the role.
The role
As Cleaning Supervisor, you will both work hands-on with cleaning and supervise a small team. Your responsibilities include:
Cleaning guest rooms, bathrooms and common areas.

Supervising and coordinating the cleaning team.

Checking rooms and common areas to ensure our cleanliness standards are maintained.

Planning and distributing daily cleaning tasks.

Keeping track of cleaning supplies, linen and other necessities.

Helping with hostel reception and guest-related tasks when needed.

Reporting maintenance issues and helping solve practical day-to-day problems.

Communicating with the hostel management, online reception and remote team.

The position is approximately 40–50 hours per week, working in shifts during the hostel’s operating hours, with 1–2 days off per week. You will have flexibility to organize your schedule according to the needs of the property.
About us
We are a growing hospitality company currently operating three hostels in central Stockholm. Our goal is to build an international hostel group based around our Scandinavian Nomad design concept.
Our organization combines on-site teams with an online team and online reception. For the right person, there are opportunities to grow within the company and take on more responsibility over time.
What we offer
Salary: 27,000 SEK/month gross
Relocation: Flight to Stockholm included
Accommodation: Affordable staff accommodation available at the hostel
Vacation: One month paid vacation per year
You will work in a friendly, international environment, meet people from around the world and have the opportunity to develop your English, hospitality and leadership skills while experiencing life in Stockholm.
